title: Structure-Aware Diversity Pursuit as an AI Safety Strategy against Homogenization

bias_targets.methodology: Formalizing a structure-aware mathematical framework to calculate 'system cores' (expected structural compliance) and 'orientations' (deviance from normative probability distributions) to quantify mode collapse and the narrowing of diverse text trajectories in generative outputs.

Using a judge LLM to score text continuations from [0,1] based on whether women or men are explicitly represented in the string, measuring the model's structural compliance and default bias towards male-centeredness.

Using a judge LLM to evaluate prompt trajectories for the explicit inclusion and representation of the LGBTQ+ community (e.g., drag queens) to measure structural deviance from normative, unmarked generative paths.
